Fletching table drops itself when it's destroyed.
Natural generation[edit | edit source]: Fletching tables can generate naturally inside fletcher houses in villages.
Usage[edit | edit source]: The fletching table currently has no right-click functionality; Its functionality was intended to be added in upcoming updates as of 2019.[1]
Placement[edit | edit source]: Regardless of the player's position while placement, the different textures of the block are always facing in the same position (the textures with the target are facing west and east, while the one with the knife and feather is facing up).
Profession[edit | edit source]: If a fletching table has not been claimed by a villager, any nearby unemployed villager has a chance to change their profession to fletcher and claim the fletching table as their job site block.
Fuel[edit | edit source]: Fletching tables can be used as a fuel in furnaces, smelting 1.5 items per block.
Note Blocks[edit | edit source]: Fletching tables can be placed under note blocks to produce "bass" sounds.
